info.description: Agent Wallets and the gateway that enforces them. Every AI agent gets a wallet — a balance, spending rules, approvals, a card and a live statement — and Lens judges each model call and payment against that wallet before it reaches the provider or the payee. Underneath: multi-provider routing with cost tracking, quality scoring and tenant isolation.
info.title: Talyvor Lens API

tags.description: Every AI agent gets a wallet — a balance, spending rules, approvals, a card and a live statement. The agent calls its models through Lens with a key of its own, and Lens judges each request and payment against its wallet before the provider or the payee sees it. Amounts are in µLXC: 1 LXC = 1,000,000 µLXC = $0.10, so $1 is 10000000.

post.description: Owner or admin. Until the time, the limit is the boost's value; from then on the rules judge it as the rules set it, with nothing to undo. The limit must be set and the value above it, and the boost applies only while the rules leave the limit as it was. A boost replaces the one the limit had.

400.description: an unknown limit, a limit not set, a value not above it, or a time not in the future

post.summary: Raise one of the agent's limits until a time

post.description: Owner or admin. The rules become exactly what they were at version — a rule added since keeps its value — and the rollback is itself a new version, recording who made it.

post.description: Moves nothing: the rules judge the request exactly as a real one, against what the agent has really spent, and everything the judgement would write is rolled back — no posting, no approval filed. With payee it is a payment to that payee; without, a question to model through provider. at (RFC 3339) asks about another time, for the active hours and the periods; now when absent.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Lens API key — Authorization: Bearer tlv_...

archived_at.description: set once the agent is archived: swept to zero, its keys revoked

description.description: what the agent is for, in its owner's words

handle.description: its @handle, once its owner picks one

keys.description: ids of the agent's own proxy keys

owner_user_id.description: the person answerable for what it spends

created_by.description: the credential that set it; empty when unknown

raised_from.description: the limit as the rules set it when the boost was set; once the rules change it, the boost no longer applies

rule.description: the limit raised, as AgentRules names it

until.description: from this time on the boost is not read and the limit is the rules' again

value.description: what it is raised to: µLXC, or requests a minute for requests_per_minute

AgentRules.description: Zero or empty means no limit. A field this schema does not name is refused (400), so a misspelt rule is never silently no rule.

active_from.description: HH:MM in timezone; with active_until, the hours it may spend

active_until.description: exclusive; earlier than active_from crosses midnight

allowed_listings.description: marketplace listings it may use; empty allows any

allowed_payees.description: the ids of the agents, listings, companies (a company names its agents and listings) and card merchants it may pay; once it names any, a payment to another is refused. Absent keeps the stored list

approval_above_ulxc.description: a request that could cost more waits for a person's approval

blocked_payees.description: the ids of the payees it may not pay; a payment to one is refused and posts nothing. Absent keeps the stored list

hourly_limit_ulxc.description: the clock hour, in timezone; absent keeps the stored cap

model_daily_limits_ulxc.description: a model, named as the agent asks for it, to what the agent may spend on it in a day, in timezone; absent keeps the stored caps

payee_daily_limits_ulxc.description: µLXC it may pay one payee in a day, by the payee's id as the payee lists name it (a company's counts its agents and listings); a payment past it is refused and posts nothing. Absent keeps the stored caps; saved, it replaces them whole

requests_per_minute.description: the requests to models it may make in any sixty seconds; one more is refused 429 and holds nothing. Absent keeps the stored cap

weekly_limit_ulxc.description: the week from Monday, in timezone; absent keeps the stored cap

change.description: set, template <id>, rollback to <n>, or before history for rules set before versions were kept

changed_by.description: the credential that changed them: operator, or its method, user and key (jwt:user:…); empty when unknown

label.description: on a platform_fee line, the fee and its rate: "Platform fee 3%"

ref.description: a payment's memo, or the request it paid for

RuleTemplate.description: Rules an agent can start from. They name every rule, so applying them replaces the agent's rules whole.
